title: Expedited rejoin stabilizer and controlled load-trim hotfix
author: Sofia Ramirez
description: Motivation: Following a recent outage reconstruction (SUP-4512) we observed an oscillation during regional rejoin where multiple nodes aggressively tried to reclaim tenant KV slots, triggering cascade redistributions and transient SLO violations. This PR introduces a short-term hotfix to: 1) introduce a gentle rejoin backoff window (per-tenant jittered delay + exponential cap) to avoid synchronized reclaims; 2) add a controlled load-trim path that softly sheds low-priority traffic during rejoin windows; and 3) emit new telemetry to make oscillation and rejoin latency visible in the Console. This change is intentionally conservative: defaults apply only during detected rejoin epochs and are disabled outside of a rejoin recovery window. Changes: - runtime/scheduler/rejoin_coordinator.go: add rejoin state machine with randomized tenant backoff and exponential cooldown logic; add tests for staggered rejoin timings. - runtime/load_trim/trimmer.go: implement priority-aware soft-trimmer that signals request proxies to shed non-critical classes via header flag and emits approximate token savings. - controlplane/telemetry/v2: add rejoin_epoch metric, tenant_rejoin_backoff_seconds histogram, and soft_trim_shed_count counter. - config/defaults.yaml: new toggle rejoin_relay.enabled (default true for this rollout window) and rejoin_relay.default_backoff_ms. - docs/ops/rejoin-playbook.md: updated playbook with diagnostic queries and rollback steps. Rollout plan: - Stage: feature gated behind rejoin_relay.enabled. - Canary: enable for 5% of tenants in us-west-2 for 2 hours, observe rejoin_epoch and token/shed metrics. - Ramp: 25% after 6 hours if no increase in 95th latency or error rate; full rollout after 24h stability. Backout: flip rejoin_relay.enabled=false; will disable new path immediately. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for coordinator state transitions - [x] e2e simulation harness run for tenant rejoin storm - [x] metrics wired to Console dashboards - [x] docs updated - [x] post-merge telemetry alert to watch for increased shed volume Monitoring and alerts: new SLO probe rule added to detect >3x baseline soft_trim_shed_count in 10m window; alert routed to SRE runbook. Notes: This is a hotfix to reduce immediate customer impact while we finalize a larger, model-aware eviction redesign. See ENG-9821 for the long-running redesign epic.
